title: Hospital Administrator
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Hospital Administrator**

*Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| Elder Care Facility*

**Company**: Universal Elder Care

**Position**: Hospital Administrator

**Location**: Kovaipudur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Experience**: 0 – 3 Years (Healthcare preferred)

**Employment Type**: Full\-Time

**Industry**: Healthcare / Elder Care Services

**Qualification**: BHA / MBA (Hospital / Healthcare Management) or equivalent

**About Universal Elder Care**

Universal Elder Care is a dedicated elder care service provider located in Kovaipudur, Coimbatore. We offer a comprehensive range of residential and home\-based care services for senior citizens, including medical assistance, rehabilitation, nursing care, and wellness programs. Our facility is driven by a team of compassionate professionals committed to delivering the highest standard of care and dignity to every resident and client we serve.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Hospital Administrator to oversee the day\-to\-day administrative and operational functions of our elder care facility. The ideal candidate will serve as the backbone of our facility operations — ensuring smooth workflow between clinical teams, maintaining compliance with healthcare regulations, managing facility resources, and delivering an excellent experience for residents and their families.

This is an excellent opportunity for early\-career professionals with a background in healthcare administration, hospital management, or a related discipline who wish to build a meaningful career in the elder care sector.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. Facility Operations \& Administration**

* Oversee the overall day\-to\-day administrative operations of the elder care facility to ensure seamless functioning across all departments.
* Coordinate between clinical staff (doctors, nurses, physiotherapists, caregivers) and administrative personnel to ensure integrated service delivery.
* Maintain and update operational procedures, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and facility policies in alignment with best practices.
* Monitor facility workflows and identify gaps or inefficiencies, recommending improvements to senior management.
* Manage facility schedules including staff duty rosters, shift allocation, and leave planning to ensure round\-the\-clock coverage.
* Supervise housekeeping, maintenance, security, laundry, and dietary departments to maintain facility standards.

**2\. Patient / Resident Admission \& Records Management**

* Coordinate the admission, discharge, and transfer processes for residents, ensuring a smooth and dignified experience for residents and their families.
* Maintain accurate and complete resident records including medical histories, treatment plans, consent forms, and progress documentation.
* Implement and manage the facility's Electronic Health Record (EHR) or Health Management Information System (HMIS) effectively.
* Ensure proper filing, retrieval, confidentiality, and security of all resident records in accordance with data protection norms.
* Prepare and maintain registers for admissions, discharges, incidents, complaints, and other mandatory records.

**3\. Regulatory Compliance \& Quality Assurance**

* Ensure the facility operates in full compliance with applicable healthcare regulations, licensing requirements, and government norms applicable to elder care institutions in Tamil Nadu.
* Coordinate facility inspections, audits, and accreditation processes, preparing all required documentation and reports.
* Implement and monitor infection prevention and control (IPC) protocols and ensure all staff adhere to hygiene and safety standards.
* Maintain a comprehensive incident reporting system and ensure timely investigation and resolution of complaints, incidents, and near\-miss events.
* Support quality improvement initiatives and facilitate internal audits to uphold clinical and service delivery standards.

**4\. Human Resources \& Staff Coordination**

* Assist in recruitment, onboarding, and orientation of administrative and support staff.
* Maintain attendance, performance records, and leave management for non\-clinical staff in coordination with the HR department.
* Coordinate staff training programs, continuing education sessions, and skill development workshops.
* Address staff concerns, resolve minor workplace issues, and escalate critical matters to senior management.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels are maintained at all times, especially during emergencies or peak care periods.

**5\. Financial Administration \& Billing**

* Oversee resident billing processes including preparation of invoices, fee collection, receipts, and follow\-up on outstanding payments.
* Maintain petty cash, day\-to\-day expense records, and vendor payment coordination in collaboration with the accounts team.
* Assist in budget planning for administrative departments and monitor adherence to approved budgets.
* Coordinate with insurance agencies, TPAs (Third Party Administrators), and government health schemes for claims processing and reimbursements where applicable.
* Generate financial reports including revenue summaries, occupancy rates, and departmental expenditure for management review.

**6\. Procurement \& Inventory Management**

* Manage procurement of administrative and non\-clinical supplies including stationery, housekeeping materials, dietary items, and facility consumables.
* Maintain inventory records, monitor stock levels, and coordinate with approved vendors for timely replenishment.
* Obtain competitive quotations and ensure cost\-effective procurement without compromising quality.
* Maintain equipment registers, coordinate preventive maintenance schedules, and ensure timely repair of facility assets.
* Liaise with medical supply vendors for timely delivery of clinical consumables in coordination with the nursing team.

**7\. Resident \& Family Relations**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for residents and their families for all administrative queries, concerns, and feedback.
* Conduct regular family interaction sessions and facility orientation programmes for new residents and their caregivers.
* Address and resolve resident or family complaints in a professional, empathetic, and timely manner.
* Maintain a visitor management system and ensure all visitors adhere to facility protocols and security procedures.
* Collect and analyze resident satisfaction feedback to identify areas for service improvement.

**8\. IT Systems \& Digital Administration**

* Manage the facility's digital systems including EHR software, scheduling tools, billing platforms, and communication systems.
* Ensure all administrative data is backed up, secure, and accessible to authorized personnel only.
* Prepare MIS reports, occupancy dashboards, and operational summaries for management review on a weekly and monthly basis.
* Coordinate with IT vendors for system maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Support digital initiatives such as telemedicine coordination, online appointment scheduling, and resident health portals.

**9\. Emergency Preparedness \& Safety**

* Develop and maintain facility emergency response plans including fire safety, medical emergencies, and natural disasters.
* Conduct periodic mock drills and safety training sessions for all staff members.
* Ensure all fire safety equipment, emergency exits, first aid kits, and medical emergency supplies are maintained and inspection\-ready.
* Liaise with local authorities including fire department, ambulance services, and healthcare bodies for emergency coordination.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Hospital Administration (BHA), Healthcare Management, Business Administration (MBA – Hospital Management), or a related field.
* Diploma in Hospital Administration or Healthcare Management will also be considered.
* Additional certifications in healthcare quality, patient safety, or facility management are an advantage.

**Experience**

* 0 to 3 years of experience in hospital or healthcare facility administration.
* Prior exposure to elder care, nursing home, rehabilitation centre, or multi\-speciality hospital environments is preferred.
* Freshers with strong academic credentials and a keen interest in healthcare administration are encouraged to apply.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Tamil and English.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and basic hospital management software.
* Understanding of healthcare regulations, patient rights, and clinical governance frameworks.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact professionally with residents, families, medical staff, and vendors.
* Problem\-solving mindset with the ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
* High integrity, confidentiality, and ethical conduct in handling sensitive resident and organizational information.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary package based on qualifications and experience.
* A structured induction program and on\-the\-job mentoring from senior healthcare administrators.
* Exposure to diverse administrative functions in a full\-spectrum elder care environment.
* Opportunities for career advancement within a growing elder care organization.
* Continuous learning through training programs, workshops, and professional development initiatives.
* A meaningful and rewarding career that makes a real difference in the lives of senior citizens.
* Collaborative, respectful, and inclusive workplace culture.

**How to Apply**

Interested and eligible candidates are requested to submit their updated resume along with a brief statement of interest to our HR team. Please mention 'Hospital Administrator – Coimbatore' in the subject line of your application email.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
A being with wild imagination, steady hands, and an artistic logic that normal humans don’t understand.

* Breathes creativity like oxygen and sees design everywhere bad or good, you judge it.

description:
Scopely is looking for a **Talent Partner ( Contract )** to join our team in Bangalore, India.



At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day \- whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.



Our Talent Acquisition team is responsible for finding \& attracting the best of the best for our business. This team sits globally in the US, UK, Spain \& India and is on a mission to engage with top talent to Inspire Play, Every Day!


**What You'll Do:**


* Own and manage full life cycle recruitment for roles across our organisation in India.
* Source and engage potential hires, maintaining a strong passive candidate pipeline with high\-touch communication.
* Develop innovative strategies to connect with and interview potential candidates.

* Build trust with candidates and provide them with complete, accurate, and inspiring information about the company and each position.
* Manage the presentation, selection, offer, negotiation, closing, and administrative components involved in full lifecycle recruiting.
* Maintain close relationships with staffing partners/vendors to ensure the talent we hire meets Scopely's bar of expectations.
* Manage campus relationships and hiring initiatives for fresher recruitment.


**About You:**


* 2\+ years of experience in full life cycle recruiting or related field
* Experience in the gaming or entertainment industry is a plus
* Experience recruiting for engineering, product, and design roles
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
* Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information


At Scopely, we create games for everyone \- and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us \& embrace the adventure!

### **About Scopely**



Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world's most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all\-time "MONOPOLY GO!" and "Pokémon GO," along with "Stumble Guys," "Star Trek™ Fleet Command," "MARVEL Strike Force," "WWE Champions," the Scrabble® franchise, "Yahtzee® With Buddies," and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live\-operates one of the most diversified and award\-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.



Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world\-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet\-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely's position as the \#1 mobile games company in the U.S. and \#2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like "MONOPOLY GO!" from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Niantic games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.



Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and "Best Workplaces for Innovators," Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.



Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.



Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. title: Manager - HRBP
description:
**Business Overview \-** 




  





***About Danone Group:***




  





 Mission: Bringing Health through Food to as Many people as Possible
 



  





 Danone is a global leader in food and beverages, focusing on Essential Dairy and Plant\-based products, Waters, and Specialized Nutrition. Our mission is to bring health through food to as many people as possible by creating nutritious products, raising awareness about healthy eating and drinking habits, and conducting our business sustainably.
 



  





 Danone’s dual focus on commercial performance and societal responsibility, combined with an ongoing commitment to innovation and the strengthening of its health\-oriented brands, has resulted in strong performance worldwide. With nearly 90,000 employees and products sold in over 120 markets, Danone has generated more than €27 billion in sales annually.
 



  





 More information can be found at www.danone.com.
 



  





***About Danone India:***




  





 India is among the countries in the APAC zone wherein Danone has its presence. Danone operates in India as Nutricia International Pvt. Ltd, focusing on nutrition with a range of products catering to pregnant mothers, infants, young children as well as adults. These products are manufactured in India and sold nationally under recognized brands such as Aptamil, Dexolac, Nusobee, and Protinex. Danone employs over 1,000 individuals across India and generates a turnover exceeding €170 million. The company's head office is in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with a manufacturing facility situated in Lalru, Punjab.
 



  





 Danone India is a Great Place To Work® certified organization, which reflects our commitment to creating a workplace where people are empowered to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and feel a true sense of belonging.
 



  





 More information can be found at https://www.danone.in/
 



  





 Want to learn more about Careers at Danone India? Visit Danone Careers
 



  





**Role and Responsibilities:** 




  





 The HR Business Partner would be engaging with business stakeholders in key HR processes including head count requirement, performance management, people coaching, development conversations, coordinating learning activities, PDR and ASR process facilitation and all HR strategic projects implementation. The HRBP would also be responsible for managing employee relations and union management (if applicable in the Line of Business) which will involve discipline and grievances management, participating in domestic inquiries, managing litigations under various labor laws (if applicable), bottom quartile management and others related activities. Improving existing practices to ensure high \& positive internal employee experience would be key to the role. Collaborating with CBU HR teams for alignment and implementation of HR processes and sharing feedback for process improvements.
 



  





**Human Resources Management** 




  





*Performance Management*



* Deploy Danone People Conversations (C1 to C5\) in line with global processes and complete HR audits.
* Coordinate and manage Performance related processes Performance Calibration, Annual Salary Review and Short\-term Incentives payouts (STI)
* Discuss with line leaders on employee performance matters and plan for employees’ promotions/performance coaching
* Consolidate performance reviews with functional heads and give consolidated data and recommendations
* Coordinate and track PIP plans for bottom quartile performers







*Headcount Management*



* Partner with business leaders for understanding optimal headcount and positions, talent needs identification in line with business goals
* Manage headcount optimization based on business needs
* Partner with business for internal transfers and assessment of talent pool to meet re\-organization needs
* Coordinate and oversee field force hiring as per process and business need







*Talent*



* Deploy IJP process to identify internal talent as per business requirements
* Contribute to talent needs identification and job requisition on sHaRe for managerial population ICIMS, and participate in the interview process as panel with business stakeholders and share feedback for managerial positions
* Train people managers on all HR Processes (Target setting, PDR, ASR etc.)
* Review re\-hire requests and share feedback







*New Joiner Management*



* Support line managers on designing and planning functional inductions of new joiners (managerial) for early performance impact
* Supporting new joiner in knowing teams, important stakeholders, conducting introduction calls for new joiners
* Run HR sessions during the Basic Training Program (BTP) and induction plans for managers on field



  





  





*Attrition and Exit Management*



* Identification of attrition risks through EWS and create mitigation plan to ensure talent availability.
* Monthly attrition analysis with business stakeholders and creating action plan to manage attrition
* Manage exit process along with line leaders, engaging in retention conversations, negotiations, exit interviews etc.
* Advise business leaders on retention strategies for key talent and support on attrition management



  





*HR Policies*



* Suggesting improvements and leading changes in HR Policies and processes from time to time for enhancing employee experience
* Ensure implementation of HR policies and guidelines for the lines of business supported



  





*Rewards and Recognition*



* Co\-ordinate with people managers for R\&R policy and facilitating the process in respective Line of Business (LOB)



  





*Payroll Management*



* Share monthly payroll inputs to central payroll team
* Managing grievances with payroll team related to payroll\-Sodexo, Mediclaim etc.
* Share resignation details and F\&F inputs with payroll team and other stakeholders



  









**Employee Relations and Social Fundamentals** 




  





*Discipline Management*



* Investigate and take appropriate actions\- issue show cause notices \& charge sheets, termination letters etc.\- for noncompliance or disciplinary issues based on investigation reports
* Manage disciplinary issues in the line of business and address employee grievances
* Coach and advise line managers to enable them with strategies of discipline management
* Prepare and participate in domestic inquiries and labor court hearings as and when required



  





*Union Management*



* Manage Union matters and related grievances, demands, expectations
* Co\-ordinate with legal consultants on case\-to\-case basis and guidance



  





  





**Employee Connect and Engagement** 




  





*Engagement Surveys*



* Drive all surveys (Danone People Survey, Pulse survey etc.) and ensure maximum participation
* Create customized action plan based on survey results and employee feedback
* Validate the action plan with functional CODIs for deployment



  





*Employee Connects*



* Regular connect with employees, people managers and functional CODIs to understand areas of opportunities and way forward
* Deploy HR brown bags to gather employee feedback
* Partner with Safety Manager to deploy Health and wellbeing initiatives



  





**Candidate Profile** 




  




* MBA from a Tier\-1 B\-School
* 3 to 5 years of relevant experience post MBA

description:
**Company Profile** 









  




 Bain \& Company is the management consulting firm that the world’s business leaders come to when they want results. Bain advises clients on strategy, operations, information technology, organization, private equity, digital transformation and strategy, and mergers and acquisition, developing practical insights that clients act on and transferring skills that make change stick. The firm aligns its incentives with clients by linking its fees to their results. Bain clients have outperformed the stock market 4 to 1\. Founded in 1973, Bain has offices in various countries, and its deep expertise and client roster cross every industry and economic sector.
 







 The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS).
 



 Global Business Services (GBS)
 



 is a network of five interconnected business\-function hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally.  Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
 










  




**Job Summary** 






  



 We are seeking a strategic and hands\-on HR Business Partner to support two critical dimensions of our organization:
 








  


* Serving as the HR Business Partner for the Executive Assistant (EA) and Management Assistant (MA) population across Asia Pacific (APAC) (50%), and
* Leading HR for our Global Business Services (GBS) Kuala Lumpur office, (50%).







  




 This role operates in a highly matrixed, multi\-country environment and requires balancing regional strategic priorities with local operational excellence. The individual will act as a trusted advisor to business and program leadership, driving talent strategy, employee experience, and organizational effectiveness, while ensuring strong governance and compliance.
 








  




**Principal Accountabilities and % of time** 









  




**1\. Regional HR Business Partner – APAC EA/MA Program (\~50%)**









  


* Serve as the HR Business Partner for the APAC EA/MA population, partnering closely with the EA/MA Program Team and functional leadership to align people's priorities with program delivery, capability needs, and evolving business requirements.
* Build strong relationships with the EA/MA Program Team, leadership, and key stakeholders,
* Partner with the APAC EA/MA Program leads on talent topics, including organizational design, workforce planning, and program effectiveness, ensuring alignment across geographies. Coordinate with local HR teams across APAC to ensure consistent application of people's practices to the EA/MA population while adapting to local market, legal, and regulatory requirements.
* Leverage data and insights to inform program talent decisions, identify trends and opportunities to improve performance, retention, and overall program effectiveness.




  
 





**2\. GBS HR Lead – GBS Kuala Lumpur (\~50%)**









  




 Serve as the HR leader for the Kuala Lumpur GBS office, owning and driving the local people agenda in alignment with global HR strategy and business priorities. 
 



* Act as a trusted advisor to office leadership, shaping talent strategy, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness for the KL office.
* Lead all local employee relations, compliance, and regulatory matters, ensuring effective risk management and alignment with local labor laws and statutory requirements.
* Helping to shape a strong office culture and employee experience, including engagement, wellbeing, and inclusion initiatives tailored to the KL environment.







  




**3\. Talent Management, Rewards \& Organizational Effectiveness**









  


* Advise leaders on performance management, promotions, and compensation decisions across both scopes.
* Analyze engagement survey results and partner with the business to drive targeted action plans to improve employee experience and retention.
* Support organizational design, role clarity, and capability building initiatives.




  
 





**4\. Employee Relations \& Risk Management**









  


* Provide oversight and guidance on employee relations matters across APAC EA/MA and direct ownership for KL\-based cases.
* Ensure alignment between global standards and local legal requirements through close partnership with local HR and Legal teams.
* Proactively identify and mitigate HR\-related risks while balancing business needs and employee experience.


* Lead investigations and disciplinary processes in the GBS KL office with sensitivity and professionalism, ensuring fairness and compliance.
* Partner with local HR teams across APAC to ensure consistent handling of ER matters while maintaining compliance with local regulations.




  
 





**5\. HR**


**Activities** 


**, Projects \& Continuous Improvement**









  


* Lead and support the implementation of global HR initiatives, projects, and transformation efforts.
* Drive process improvements and operational efficiencies across HR service delivery.
* Leverage data, analytics, and emerging tools to enhance decision\-making and HR impact.


* Champion employee wellbeing, engagement, and workplace safety initiatives for the KL GBS Office, embedding them into day\-to\-day operations
* Act as key liaison with relevant government agencies where required, including managing in\-person engagements, ensuring timely submission and filing of statutory documentation, and staying up to date with evolving local laws and regulatory requirements to maintain full compliance.
* Ensure consistent, high\-quality HR support with a strong client\-service mindset.
* Manage benefits administration and support implementation of benefits strategies and vendor transitions at the GBS KL office.
* Advise the business on policy matters, ensuring compliance with internal policies and local labor regulations for the GBS KL population.







  




**6\. Team Leadership \& Development**









  


* Manage, coach, and develop direct reports (e.g., HR Specialist), ensuring strong execution of local HR operations and capability building.


* Foster a high\-performance, collaborative, and learning\-oriented HR team environment.







  




 In addition to the responsibilities outlined above, this role may be required to support or lead additional initiatives, projects, or activities aligned with business needs and the evolving HR agenda
 








  




**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** 









  


* Strong business acumen and ability to translate business needs into HR strategies
* Proven ability to operate in a complex, matrixed, multi\-country environment
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including with senior leaders
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive insights from data
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and operate with high ownership
* Demonstrated ability to exercise effective judgment, sensitivity, discretion, and creativity in changing needs and situations
* Excellent people management and team leadership capabilities.
* Willingness to participate in calls across time zones as needed
* Proven ability to serve as a key liaison with government agencies, managing in\-person engagements, overseeing timely statutory filings, and ensuring compliance with evolving local laws and regulations.







  




**Experience** 









  


* 8\+ years of progressive HR experience, ideally in a global or matrixed organization
* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience is required
* Strong experience in employee relations and risk management
* Prior experience as an HR Business Partner or HR Generalist
* Experience in shared services / GBS environments and/or regional HR exposure preferred
* Demonstrated experience in change and conflict management and organizational transformation
* Some travel required (estimated to be once or twice yearly)

title: HR Manager (Talent Management)
description:
The Human Resources Manager (Talent Management) drives initiatives to support a culture of learning and development at Husco. This position will drive and maintain effective programs for employee attraction, retention, promotion, and succession planning. The Human Resources Manager (Talent Management) will be responsible for talent attraction including pipeline development, agency partnership, and recruitment as well as design, develop, deliver, and maintain all employee development, oversee employee reviews, manage succession planning conversations and other programming. They will be responsible for supporting and improving a culture that attracts and retains a talented, engaged, high\-performing workforce.
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities**
* Attracts the Top Talent in our Industry. Coordinates recruitment/employment activities for all office positions. Attracts, develops, retains and motivates employees at all levels. Create and maintain a continual/active flow of candidates by utilizing advanced internet searching skills, cold and warm calling, networking, database mining, referrals, social/business websites, and other non\-traditional avenues. Engage in timely and appropriate communications with all candidates, hiring managers, recruiting managers, peer recruiters, vendors and other stakeholders to create a highly positive experience. Benchmarks employee compensation and benefits programs and provides feedback in relation to new programs, changes and renewals. Develop and manage the onboarding process for all new employees. This includes facilitating new employee orientation.
* Lead the Local Talent Planning, Critical Roles, and Succession Programs. Drive the local talent planning and succession management process, ensuring alignment with the broader global strategy. This role will partner closely with site leadership to identify critical roles, assess talent readiness, and implement development plans that support long\-term workforce sustainability. The manager will also contribute insights and data to the global talent pipeline, helping shape enterprise\-wide succession strategies and leadership development initiatives.
* Annual Review Process and Coaching: Oversee and administer annual performance review process for all local office employees. Coach managers on writing and conducting effective performance appraisals, and coach employees and managers on creating actionable goals through effective performance and development conversations.
* Function as a cultural steward and engagement of Husco. Implement the annual engagement survey, analyze results, provide data to key stakeholders, and drive action planning for improving employee engagement. Create opportunities throughout the year to promote employee engagement and satisfaction. Facilitate employee milestone moments including onboarding, performance, and separation discussions. Analyze and quantify feedback for trends and actionable changes for organizational improvement. Be available as a ‘voice of reason’ to employees and leaders for career development and coaching moments.
* Design, deliver, and maintain training programs. Lead training programs for India and partner with global HR leaders and training committees to meet organization and employee development needs. Create and deliver or partner with external experts to provide all soft skills, leadership, and technical training. Utilize training validation methods including competency testing and participant evaluations to measure training outcomes. Maintain thorough understanding of industry best practices for employee and leadership development tools and practices. Identify learning offerings and participate in the selection of vendors, suppliers and other contracted resources.
* Strong Team Player and Contributor. Able to work well with colleagues and produce results within a fast\-paced and high\-pressure atmosphere. Combines strong attention to detail with an orientation towards results/execution. Assist with the maintenance and interpretation of all company policies, employee handbooks, and on\-boarding and orientation materials. Provide support as needed to Human Resource team members to assure the attainment of departmental objectives.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in human resource or a related field
* 8\+ years of work experience in human resources, specifically in talent development and recruiting.
* Experience driving talent initiatives and building relationships that gain buy\-in and commitment to the value of learning initiatives.
* Experience sourcing and recruiting technical professionals, specifically engineers and IT professionals.
* Ability to organize and prioritize multiple tasks; manage and meet deadlines. Project management experience is a plus.
* Ability to establish credibility and build collaborative partnerships with all levels of management and individuals across a broad range of business groups.
* Experience in aligning projects, tasks and goals with departmental and organizational strategy.
* Proficiency in verbal and written English

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

 In this role, you will shape and deliver key components of the employee experience across Global Businesses \& Functions, with a focus on inclusion, culture, and employee voice. You will work across a mix of project\-based initiatives and recurring processes, ensuring that employee insights are consistently translated into meaningful actions that improve how people experience BCG.
   

  

 You will collaborate with People Team and business leaders to identify priorities, design solutions, and drive execution. This role requires balancing structured analysis with practical implementation—connecting data, insights, and programs to deliver measurable impact.
   

  

* Analyze and synthesize employee data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities, sharing actionable insights with senior stakeholders
* Serve as GBF People Team lead for employee voice initiatives, including People Survey, pulse checks, and dashboards, ensuring insights are translated into clear actions
* Partner with leaders to co\-develop and implement action plans that strengthen engagement, inclusion, and culture
* Design and evolve programs that reinforce a strong, inclusive culture (e.g., Unlocking Potential initiatives, recognition, manager enablement)
* Build and scale frameworks, tools, and processes that enable consistent, high\-quality employee experience practices across teams and geographies
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of projects, from problem framing through execution, navigating complex stakeholder environments
* Manage recurring processes and reporting cycles, ensuring reliability, quality, and continuous improvement
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve how employee insights and programs are delivered


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* You bring 6–8\+ years of experience in consulting, strategy, analytics, employee engagement, diversity and inclusion, or a related field
* You bring strong analytical skills and the ability to quickly learn and navigate tools and dashboards (e.g., Excel, Tableau, MS Suite, AI platforms) to generate clear insights and actions
* You bring experience working with employee data, surveys, or engagement\-related areas
* You bring the ability to structure ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical solutions
* You bring strong communication skills, with experience creating clear, compelling materials for senior audiences
* You bring the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across teams and levels
* You bring a high level of ownership, with a track record of independently driving successful projects end\-to\-end
* You bring an understanding of the dynamics that shape employee experience, engagement, and retention, with a demonstrated commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You will be part of the Innovation, Change and Employee Experience team within the Global Businesses \& Functions People Team, working closely with colleagues across multiple pillars, including HR Business Partners, Talent Partners, Regional HR Delivery teams, Learning \& Development, and Talent Acquisition.
   

  

 You will also partner directly with business leaders and teams across Global Services, Practice Area Management \& Operations, BCG Vantage, and BCG U to translate employee insights into practical actions and initiatives. This role operates within a highly collaborative, global environment, where you will engage with diverse stakeholders to drive meaningful improvements in employee experience.
   

  

 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person work is essential to our culture, mentorship, and professional development. In this role, you are expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients, approximately 50% of the time in a typical week. title: Vice President Human Resources
description:
**Job Overview** 




 We are seeking a strategic and dynamic
 **Vice President – Human Resources** 
 to lead the people agenda across our healthcare and education ecosystem. The role will drive talent strategy, organizational development, workforce planning, employee engagement, compliance, and HR transformation initiatives aligned with institutional growth objectives.
 



 The incumbent will serve as a key strategic partner to leadership in building a high\-performance, people\-centric culture across the organization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Pre\-Joining Management** 



* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment strategy and execution for faculty, clinicians, nurses and non\-clinical talent.
* Drive workforce planning, talent sourcing, assessment and selection processes.
* Strengthen hiring quality through structured evaluation frameworks and training of line managers on selection methodologies.
* Build robust talent pipelines to support organizational growth.



**2\. Selection, Onboarding \& Orientation** 



* Oversee seamless onboarding and orientation programs for new hires across business units.
* Design and institutionalize structured induction processes to ensure faster integration and productivity.
* Partner with departmental leaders to enhance candidate and employee experience.



**3\. Employee Life Cycle Management** 



* Lead the complete employee lifecycle from onboarding to development, engagement and retention.
* Drive learning \& development initiatives, leadership capability building and succession planning.
* Oversee performance management, appraisal and rewards systems that foster high performance.
* Develop and monitor HR metrics and dashboards including attrition, absenteeism, compensation trends and workforce analytics.
* Support current and future business needs through talent development, engagement and retention strategies.
* Foster a positive, collaborative and high\-performing work culture.



**4\. Employee Relations \& Severance Management** 



* Manage employee relations, grievance handling and conflict resolution.
* Oversee labor mediation, disciplinary matters and claim handling.
* Ensure fair, compliant and dignified separation and severance processes.



**5\. HR Strategy, Policy \& Transformation** 



* Develop and implement progressive HR strategies aligned with organizational goals.
* Review, strengthen and institutionalize HR policies, systems and SOPs across the group.
* Lead organizational development and HR transformation initiatives.
* Drive regulatory compliance awareness through policy communication and training programs.
* Act as a bridge between management and employees to strengthen trust and engagement.



**6\. Administration, Compliance \& Legal** 



* Ensure legal and statutory compliance across all aspects of human resource management.
* Oversee HR administration related to faculty and staff matters.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth institutional operations.
* Support governance, audits, compliance reviews and other strategic or operational responsibilities as assigned.



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources / MSW or equivalent from a reputed institution.
* 15\+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, preferably in healthcare organizations.
* Proven experience in strategic HR, talent management, employee relations and compliance.
* Experience in leading large, diverse and multi\-location teams preferred.



**Key Competencies** 



* Strategic HR Leadership
* Talent Management \& Organizational Development
* Workforce Planning \& Succession Management
* Employee Relations \& Conflict Resolution
* HR Analytics \& Performance Management
* Policy, Compliance \& Labor Law Expertise
* Stakeholder Management
* Change Management \& Culture Building
* Strong Business Acumen and Leadership Presence



  





**Compensation:** 
 Up to ₹18 LPA (negotiable for the right candidate).

title: SDR SaaS Sales – Fresher
description:
**About Shinkly**

Shinkly Private Limited is a software company building modern SaaS products, including Voidfull \- https://voidfull.com (all\-in\-one content management) and LogChimp \- https://logchimp.app (customer feedback collection).

We focus on building high\-quality, product\-led software and scaling these products to a global audience. As an early\-stage startup, we believe in experimentation, learning quickly, and working closely together to build meaningful products.

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a **highly driven fresher** who has completed **at least 7 months of internship in tech/SaaS sales** and wants to build a serious career in B2B SaaS.

This is not a “lead gen” role — you’ll get **exposure to the full sales cycle**, working directly with the founder to generate pipeline, talk to prospects, and contribute to closing deals.

If you’re curious, hungry, and willing to learn by doing — this role is for you.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify and research potential customers (startups, SaaS teams, founders)
* Reach out via cold email, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels
* Qualify inbound and outbound leads
* Conduct initial discovery calls to understand customer pain points
* Support demos and follow\-ups with prospects
* Maintain CRM and track sales pipeline consistently
* Work closely with the founder on messaging, positioning, and GTM experiments
* Share insights from conversations to improve product and sales strategy

**Who Should Apply**

* Fresher with minimum 7 months internship experience in tech/SaaS sales, or BD
* Strong communication skills (written \+ verbal)
* Comfortable talking to new people and handling rejection
* Self\-starter who can work in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment
* Curious mindset — willing to learn sales by actually doing it
* Basic understanding of SaaS or B2B products

**Good to Have (Not Mandatory)**

* Experience with cold emailing / LinkedIn outreach
* Exposure to CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, etc.)
* Experience working in a startup or remote team
* Understanding of Product\-Led Growth (PLG)

**What You’ll Get**

* Hands\-on exposure to real SaaS sales (not just theory)
* Opportunity to work directly with the founder
* Learn full sales cycle — from prospecting to closing
* Fast growth based on performance (not tenure)
* Flexible, remote\-friendly work environment
* Potential transition into a full\-time high\-paying sales role

**Compensation Structure**

Our compensation model is designed for candidates who are confident in their ability to generate pipeline and close deals. To reward performance with strong earning potential and a clear pathway to a fixed base salary.

Phase 1: Ramp\-Up (Commission\-Driven)

* 20% of subscription revenue every month *(starting from the second month)*
* ₹3000 INR bonus on your first deal worth more than $50 USD
* ₹500 INR guarantee for every new deal you close
* No cap on earnings.

This phase gives you a high upside from day one and helps us identify strong performers quickly.

Phase 2: Base Salary \+ Commission

* Unlock a base salary of ₹20,000 INR/month after generating a minimum of $300 USD MRR
* Continued 5–10% upsell commissions
* Future increments possible based on consistent performance

Why This Structure

This aligns with early\-stage startup realities while giving high\-performers a fast path to guaranteed income. Strong performers typically unlock Phase 2 quickly.

There is no established sales process — you will need to figure things out as you go.

What makes you a strong fit for this kind of high\-uncertainty, outbound\-focused sales role?

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a sharp, analytically driven individual who thrives on making sense of numbers, processes, and business realities. This role sits at the heart of how we run, improve, and grow our business — and you will be expected to bring structure, curiosity, and a bias for action to everything you do.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Strategy Consultant, your primary focus will be on ensuring the business unit runs efficiently — tracking performance, strengthening controls, writing and improving processes, and driving operational excellence. Over time, you will also support strategic initiatives including M\&A evaluation and IPO\-related data preparation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business Unit P\&L \& Operational Performance
* Own the monthly P\&L review process — track revenue lines, cost heads, gross margins, and EBITDA; identify variances against budget and prior periods.
* Prepare detailed MIS reports, financial dashboards, and performance scorecards for leadership on a weekly and monthly basis.
* Analyse trends in revenue, cost, and profitability across business lines, customers, and geographies to surface actionable insights.
* Monitor working capital metrics — debtor days, creditor days, inventory levels, and cash flow patterns — and flag concerns proactively.
* Track and report on key business KPIs; build simple models to forecast performance and test sensitivities.
* Assist in annual budgeting and quarterly re\-forecasting exercises by compiling inputs, challenging assumptions, and preparing consolidated views.
* Design and maintain internal control mechanisms to prevent revenue leakage, cost overruns, and compliance lapses.
* Conduct periodic internal audits of transactions, approvals, and reconciliations; escalate exceptions to the reporting manager.
* Track outstanding receivables and payables; liaise with accounts team to ensure timely closures and accurate books.
* Process Writing \& Continuous Improvement
* Document existing business processes across departments in a structured, clear format — creating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process flowcharts, and control checklists.
* Identify process gaps, redundancies, and manual workarounds; propose and help implement streamlined alternatives.
* Work with teams on the ground to understand how work actually gets done vs. how it is supposed to get done — and design practical solutions that stick.
* Establish a process review calendar and ensure SOPs are updated periodically to reflect changes in operations, regulations, or systems.
* Track implementation of process improvement initiatives and measure impact through defined metrics (turnaround time, error rates, cost savings, etc.).
* Support automation and digitisation efforts by mapping current processes and identifying candidate workflows for technology intervention.
* Build a centralised process documentation repository accessible to relevant stakeholders.
* Mergers \& Acquisitions (M\&A) Support
* Assist in identifying and profiling potential M\&A targets — compile company overviews, financial summaries, and industry context.
* Build and maintain financial models for deal evaluation — including revenue projections, cost structures, and basic valuation frameworks (DCF, revenue multiples).
* Prepare structured investment briefs and evaluation summaries for presentation to decision\-makers.
* Support due diligence by collating and organising financial data, contracts, regulatory filings, and operational information.
* Track relevant sector trends, publicly available deal data, and comparable transaction benchmarks.
* IPO Readiness — Data \& Preparation Support
* Assist in collating and organising historical financial data, operational metrics, and business disclosures required for IPO documentation.
* Compile inputs for the Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) as directed — primarily data gathering, formatting, and fact\-checking.
* Coordinate with auditors, legal advisors, and merchant bankers to provide requested information in a timely manner.
* Maintain an IPO readiness tracker covering pending action items, document submissions, and milestone timelines.
* Prepare basic benchmarking data on listed peer companies — valuations, financials, and disclosure formats — for reference by senior advisors.

* Solid understanding of financial statements, P\&L mechanics, and accounting fundamentals.
* Proficiency in MS Excel; working knowledge of financial modelling and MIS reporting.
* Excellent written communication — able to write crisp SOPs, process notes, and analytical reports.

* High ownership mindset — takes tasks to completion without needing to be followed up.
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic, multi\-priority environment where the scope of work evolves.

title: Network Engineer, IP
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in designing and implementing networking systems.
* 3 years of experience with TCP/IP\-based, routing, and network management protocols.
* Experience in network protocols, architectures, methodologies, and in scripting or programming languages (e.g., Python).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience with planning and designing large\-scale networks (e.g., multiple sites, multiple products, etc.).
* Experience with Wide Area Network (WAN) technologies, including disaggregated networking or software\-defined networking concepts.
* Experience with modern network management interfaces and protocols (e.g., gRPC, gNMI, OpenConfig).
* Ability to lead technical initiatives and influence Engineering teams.


**About The Job**
 Google is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services.
   

  

 Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define, and develop the implementation of test strategies and architectures for critical WAN infrastructure projects.
* Design and execute comprehensive functional, integration, performance, and system\-level testing for complex network devices and management systems.
* Drive the creation and enhancement of scalable test automation frameworks, tools, and infrastructure.
* Collaborate closely with Network Architecture, Software Engineering, and Product teams to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle and influence design for testability.
* Diagnose and resolving complex issues across multi\-vendor network environments.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. description:
**About AlphaSense**
 The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision\-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
   

  

 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S\&P 500\. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We’re looking for a hands\-on Network Engineer to design, deploy, and enable our global corporate network across offices in APAC. You’ll be the technical expert for physical and virtual networking architecture, driving automation, and ensuring our infrastructure is resilient, scalable, and vendor\-agnostic. This role will partner closely with Corporate Technology, Network Security, and Security Engineering and requires the ability to travel within APAC to support our regional offices.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Architect and implement LAN/WAN/SD\-WAN and Wi\-Fi for multiple global offices.
* Manage Cisco Meraki switches/routers and APs, while staying vendor\-agnostic for future integrations.
* Implement and manage Wi\-Fi EAP (Enterprise Authentication), certificate\-based authentication, and enforce zero\-trust access controls.
* Plan and optimize enterprise Wi\-Fi, including RF design, surveys, and performance tuning.
* Build secure cloud and hybrid networking (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Automate deployments and configuration management with Python, Ansible, and IaC tools (Terraform, GitOps).
* Implement observability and alerting; drive improvements in MTTR and service reliability.
* Support compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001\) with configs, change control, and documentation.
* Travel regionally (approx. 25–40% during buildouts) for on\-site deployments and architecture reviews.


 Who You Are
   

  

* 8–10\+ years in enterprise networking, with multi\-site design and operations experience.
* Deep expertise in routing, switching, and segmentation.Proven experience with Cisco networking technology, especially Cisco Meraki.
* Proficient in Python and Ansible for automation.
* Skilled in NAC/RADIUS integrations with identity providers (Okta, Azure AD).
* Strong understanding of certificate\-based authentication, EAP, and zero\-trust architectures.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and leadership skills.
* Willing and able to travel internationally for deployments.


**Nice To Have**
* Cloud networking depth (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Experience with SASE/ZTNA platforms(Cloudflare/Zscaler).
* Professional certifications (CCNP, CCIE, JNCIP, etc.)


 AlphaSense is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non\-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
   

  

 In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
   

  

 Recruiting Scams and Fraud
   

  

 We At AlphaSense Have Been Made Aware Of Fraudulent Job Postings And Individuals Impersonating AlphaSense Recruiters. These Scams May Involve Fake Job Offers, Requests For Sensitive Personal Information, Or Demands For Payment. Please Note
   

  

* AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
* All official communications will come from an @alpha\-sense.com email address.
* If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.


 If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

 functioning leg at present

 (session drops/throttling, unreasonable latency impacts, etc \- currently see
 



 \~200ms hit on some traffic)

 More mature tiered scheme necessary for long term

 ToRs

title: Technical Writer
description:
Join Us as a Technical Writer!
   

  

 Are you ready to make a significant impact in an innovative environment? At ORBCOMM, we’re on the hunt for a passionate  Technical Writer  who thrives in a fast\-paced, agile setting. We want you to transform your ideas into action and drive our mission forward!
   

  

 Why You’ll Love Working Here:
   

  

 As a key member of our Technical Publications team, you will share the responsibility of designing, authoring, and publishing the documentation that supports ORBCOMM’s Industrial IoT offerings, from peripheral Installation Guides to platform User Guides and everything in between. In this role, you will facilitate information gathering across a multitude of internal teams, from hardware, to firmware, to our SaaS applications and mobile groups, to help ensure our customers have the best experience we can provide.
   

  

 With a flexible hybrid working schedule,  you can enjoy the best of both worlds—engaging in\-person collaboration at either our Galway, Ireland or Hyderabad, India offices, while also enjoying the autonomy and comfort of remote work.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Plan, research, write, and edit documentation, including help text, user guides, technical documentation, release notes for software, operational guides, etc., while following processes, guidelines, and operating procedures.
* Maintain high documentation quality standards.
* Determine documentation requirements and make plans for meeting them.
* Assess the audience’s needs and adjust tone and terminology to ensure understanding of the technical information.
* Organize and structure technical content in a way that makes it easy for the reader to follow.
* Meet with developers, programmers, subject matter experts, and project managers to gather information and learn about specific products or processes.
* Investigate the accuracy of the information collected by making direct use of the material being documented.
* Gather feedback from stakeholders to improve technical documentation.
* Provide guidance and knowledge transfer to team members.
* Maintain existing documentation content to ensure it is current.
* Perform any other work related to this role.


**Who You Are**
 You’re a strategic thinker with a knack for operational excellence, ready to tackle multiple priorities with agility and grace. If you have:
   

  

* 4\+ years’ experience with Madcap Flare and Capture(Intermediate level or higher).
* 3 to 5years’ experience in a similar position.
* Bachelor’s degree in English, Technical Writing, or related field required.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat.
* Familiarity with Jira for task tracking.
* Familiarity with version control repositories and clients such as TortoiseSVN.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and detail\-oriented .
* Ability to manage your daily workload and juggle multiple projects with minimal supervision.
* Ability to convey complex information in a clear and concise manner.
* Ability to meet multiple concurrent deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Ability to edit and proofread our work.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and meet very tight delivery schedules.


 Then we want to meet you!
   

  

 The Benefits of Working Here
   

  

 A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.
   

  

 How We Hire
   

  

 ORBCOMM uses technology\-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human\-led, tech\-enabled culture.
   

  

**About Us**
 At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data\-driven decisions. Our industry\-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at  www.orbcomm.com !
   

  

 Ready to Join Us?
   

  

 We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth\-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.
   

  

 We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
   

  

 At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary:**
 Performs information development tasks as an individual contributor. TW operates under minimal supervision from LTW or STW in the development and delivery of information products.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Works as a self\-sufficient team member with minimal guidance
* Applies processes and tools; recommends improvements
* Expected to learn new technologies and continue to expand expertise
* Communicates well within the team and with extended team members; escalates issues when required
* Collaborates effectively in virtual teams

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering/computer science/technical communication, or equivalent discipline
* Knowledge of technical writing concepts. Certification in technical documentation is preferred.
* Understanding of Product Life Cycle management in systems engineering environment
* Knowledge of information concepts
* Team Player

**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
   

  

 Senior Technical Writer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru \& Chennai, India
   

  

**Department:** 
 Technical Communication Center of Excellence
   

  

**Company:** 
 Xylem Water Solutions India Private Limited, Global Capability Center, Bangalore
   

  

**About Xylem**
 Xylem is a leading global water technology company committed to solving the world’s most challenging water issues through innovation. Our mission is to enable sustainable, efficient water use and management for communities, industries, and the environment.
   

  

**About The Position**
 As a Senior Technical Writer at Xylem, you will be part of the Global Technical Communication Center of Excellence, responsible for developing world\-class customer documentation (Hardware/Software). You will author and manage content within a Component Content Management System (CCMS), collaborating closely with Project Coordinators and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) globally. Your work will support customers of Xylem products and systems through clear, accurate, and user\-focused documentation such as Installation and Operation Instructions, Service Manuals, and other technical publications.
   

  

 As you grow in this role, you will have opportunities to contribute to continuous improvement projects, process optimization, and training initiatives within Xylem’s documentation ecosystem.
   

  

**About The Technical Communication Center Of Excellence**
 A global team of technical information specialists responsible for developing customer product information across Xylem’s product portfolio. The team focuses on intelligent content reuse using XML\-based technologies, ensuring all publications are customer\-centric, reusable, and globally consistent across multiple outputs, channels, and languages.
   

  

 Prominent collaterals include Installation and Operation Instructions, Datasheets, Quick Guides, UI Guides, and UX Guides, Technical specifications etc.
   

  

 The team consists of a Content Development (Production) Team, a Localization Team, and a Documentation Systems Team.
   

  

**About The Team In Bengaluru \& Chennai (GCC)**
 The Global Capability Center (GCC) in Bengaluru \& Chennai serves as a shared service; resources supporting Xylem’s global product portfolio — including pumps, turbines, monitoring and control systems, and water analysis equipment. The team contributes to product design, development, testing, and technical documentation to deliver innovative and reliable water technology solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Content Development
   

  

* Develop reusable, structured technical content aligned with Xylem’s authoring guidelines, information model, and style guide.
* Conduct task analysis (TA) and prepare annotated topic lists (ATL).
* Create and maintain Topics, Chaptermaps, Bookmaps, and metadata within the CCMS.
* Produce and maintain illustrations, graphics, and photo\-realistic renderings.
* Ensure the completion of review cycle and software\-assisted checks for grammar, style, and terminology.
* Initiate translation requests and coordinate translation reviews.
* Communicate release updates to stakeholders via designated channels.
* Contribute to the development of the CCMS structure, templates, and information model.
* Participate in initiatives to enhance documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and content governance.


**Required Qualifications**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electronics, Aeronautical, Computer Science, or equivalent field).


**Experience**
* 4–6 years of professional experience as a Technical Writer (Senior level) in an international, English\-language environment.
* Proven expertise in DITA XML authoring and single\-sourcing practices.
* Basic experience creating technical illustrations in vector or raster formats.


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

 Core Skills
   

  

* Excellent command of written and spoken English.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Detail\-oriented, structured, and dependable on meeting deadlines.
* Effective communicator with global, cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with Simplified Technical English (STE) and style guides such as the Microsoft or Chicago Manual of Style.
* Understanding of DDLC, SDLC, and Agile workflows.
* Knowledge of single sourcing, metadata management, and conditional profiling.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Proficiency in DITA XML and CCMS platforms such as Astoria On\-Demand or AEM.
* Skilled in XML editors such as Oxygen XML Editor or Arbortext Editor.
* Experience with terminology and content quality tools such as Acrolinx.
* Proficiency with illustration tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Creo Illustrate, Keyshot).
* Experience with collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Understanding of content publishing pipelines and localization workflows.
* Working knowledge of XML\-based formats and related technologies (XQuery, metadata tagging).
* Interest in GenAI and automation using Python or similar programming languages is desirable.


 Assessment Process
   

  

* Candidates will complete a writing and structuring test to demonstrate technical English and content organization skills.
* Successful candidates will advance to subsequent interview rounds with technical and hiring teams


 Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re\-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.
